Log ends at 03:59:27 still throwing 503s — ongoing, not resolved.

**On-call handoff:**

```
INCIDENT: Gateway 503s
STATUS: Ongoing (not yet resolved as of last log line 03:59:27Z)

ROOT CAUSE:
Deploy dep-4471 (gateway, a.novak, "connection-per-request for
pool isolation") changed gateway.pool.perRequest false -> true
at config generation 119 (applied 02:13:41Z). This exhausts the
20-connection pool under load — each request now holds its own
connection instead of sharing. Every 503 pairs 1:1 with
ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED (size 20, in_use 20, waiting N). Backlog
(waiting count) climbed from 13 at onset to 71-74 by end of log
— actively degrading, not stabilizing.

IMPACT WINDOW:
Start: 2026-03-14T02:14:18Z (first 503, req-07401)
First warning sign: 02:14:14Z (pool acquire slow warning)
End: still active at 03:59:27Z (log cutoff)
Duration so far: ~1h45m
Total 503s logged: 548

SCOPE:
Gateway only. logs/worker.log shows workers/DB pool unaffected
(only 1 unrelated pre-existing WARN, known issue OPS-2210, at
02:36:22Z, 22min after onset — not correlated).

ACTION - ROLL BACK:
dep-4471 (gateway config deploy, 02:12:00-02:14:00Z).
Revert gateway.pool.perRequest to false (or roll back full
config generation 119 -> 118). This should also implicitly
revert the timeout bump (upstreamMs 2000->2500) bundled in the
same generation — confirm that's acceptable or reapply separately.
```

Next: page a.novak (deploy author) and execute the rollback of dep-4471.
